decision_conditions: The boundary treatment, by virtue of the design of the gates (which appear solid in many views due to the railing design),  height, extent and scale, represents a visually intrusive and incongruous form of development, being out of keeping with the open character of the streetscene. As a result, the development contradicts the Havering Local Plan (adopted 2021), the London Plan (2021), and the Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document (2011).

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: Consideration was given to seeking amendments, but given conflict with adopted planning policy, it was decided that planning permission should be refused.
description: Retrospective application to retain front boundary wall and gates
